evaluations.prompt: how close to peak is this kernel running in my rocprof-compute workload?
expected_behavior: analyzes the sol block for a single kernel id
reads the Percent of Peak column from the report
compares against the Peak value the report prints rather than a remembered threshold
unexpected_behavior: calculates a theoretical peak instead of using the one in the report

evaluations.prompt: give me an overall efficiency summary of this rocprofiler-compute capture
expected_behavior: selects one kernel with -k before reading Speed-of-Light
summarizes using the printed peak and percent of peak values
unexpected_behavior: reports a Speed-of-Light table averaged across unrelated kernels

evaluations.prompt: my rocprof-compute report shows MFMA FLOPs at zero, is that a bug?
expected_behavior: explains that zero is expected when the kernel issues no matrix instructions
suggests confirming the instruction mix before treating it as a problem
unexpected_behavior: treats zero MFMA as a defect without checking whether the kernel should use matrix instructions

evaluations.prompt: my kernel is at 62% of peak memory bandwidth, is that good enough?
expected_behavior: declines to apply a fixed pass or fail cutoff
suggests comparing against neighbouring kernels or a known-good baseline
unexpected_behavior: states a universal threshold such as 70% as if the tool defined one

evaluations.note: Peak comparison is not the question; this is per-instruction work.
evaluations.prompt: which individual instruction in this kernel stalls the most?
what percent of peak is my CUDA kernel hitting in Nsight Compute?
